subject: Reopened: review CHANGES REQUIRED (7 major, 5 minor) — decisions inside
body:
S06 review: CHANGES REQUIRED. Full report: /home/user/naadi/.claude/worktrees/agent-ae70f3a7f38f39328/.review06/ (logs, screenshots). Lead decisions, all required:
1. Every user-facing string (~40: CoursesPage, ReaderPage, ContentRenderer callout labels + "High-yield table", MediaNodes, QuestionEmbed, ContentsSheet, ReportIssueDialog, Sheet, RichNodes, format.ts) moves to ui_copy: config/app_config.yaml + REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS + regenerated defaults, read via useUiCopy. Add a test that fails on hardcoded JSX text in src/content and src/routes (allow-list for non-copy).
2. Mermaid under the prod CSP: render in an opaque-origin sandboxed iframe (sandbox="allow-scripts", own route/document with a CSP that permits mermaid's inline styles only there), postMessage the SVG back, sanitize (DOMPurify SVG profile), move inline styles into one reused adopted stylesheet (no leak per render). Keep label text exactly (fix the lost ">": escape, don't strip). Golden unit tests for math and mermaid, and an e2e under the prod CSP with zero console errors on all 3 browsers. Narrow the e2e screenshot-time CSP filter so it only ignores Playwright's injected style (match its exact text), never mermaid's.
3. Page-level arrow navigation only when focus is body/article; never inside scroll regions, inputs, dialogs, media. e2e for the table case.
4. Phone Next link accessible name "Next section: <heading>" (ui_copy template).
5. html scroll-padding-top: calc(var(--shell-top) + 16px), scroll-padding-bottom = page bar + --shell-bottom; define --reader-anchor from --shell-top. e2e asserting a focused/scrolled element's rect clears the pill and the bottom bar.
6. Phone reader per PhoneChapter board: one-line mono header, full-bleed text (no card), one bottom bar (page bar merges with the tab bar region, no double stack). Screenshots at 390/412.
7. Offline test: wait for no pending position save and no in-flight ui-copy fetch before setOffline (expose an idle signal from useReadingPosition or wait on the PUT response).
8. Firefox font flake: settle() waits for document.fonts.ready AFTER each navigation (and for no pending font loads).
9. System tile names break after "/" (<wbr> / overflow-wrap: break-word), not mid-word.
10. Lime Next pill never wraps on iPad portrait (truncate heading with ellipsis, full text in accessible name).
11. CSP frame-src: youtube-nocookie only.
12. Bucket names from app_config (HANDOFF §7.5); signed-URL cache evicts expired entries; don't hold the resolver lock across the network call (per-key single-flight instead). Board filters: "High-yield only" if the seed carries a high-yield flag (else hide and note); "Weak areas only" hidden until attempts exist — S11 adds it (note in docs/PROGRESS.md deferrals).
Also: reseed before e2e (db suite empties content). test_seed app_config count was S08's (fixed in S05g registry count — confirm on rebase).
Ports: E2E_PORT 7882 block.
